name: Pitchfork
summary: The pitchfork is one of the manual hay tools named by the official store. The screenshots show it in first-person use beside the pile and a container.

data.operation: Use the current handling prompts to collect and move hay. The store screenshot illustrates the tool’s position; it does not establish a universal load size or number of actions.
data.check: Compare handling effort with your current shovel and transport options. If carrying is the slow part, check the next transport upgrade instead of assuming another hand tool solves it.

imageAlt: First-person pitchfork held in front of the hay pile.
imageCaption: The fork is held directly against the hay pile. Follow your current interaction prompts for handling; this image does not show a needle location. Official Steam screenshot.
